meta.title: Offcut — a magazine, on Mētis
meta.description: A quarterly about wood on the Mētis theme, dressed in the theme’s own magazine furniture: a dark bar with the menu in it, a wordmark the width of the page, the cover story, the issue as a list of real posts, and the theme’s big dark footer.
meta.author: jamiemarsland

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
update_option( 'gogh_booted_as', 'metis-magazine' );
wp_set_current_user( 1 );
try { wp_trash_post( 1 ); } catch ( \Throwable $e ) {}
try { wp_trash_post( 2 ); } catch ( \Throwable $e ) {}
$def = json_decode( base64_decode( '' ), true );
$r = gogh_site_def_boot( $def );
if ( is_wp_error( $r ) ) { error_log( 'gogh metis boot: ' . $r->get_error_message() ); }
